fact: In March 2022 the NCRA's Director-General said Section 25 of the National Civil Registration Act 2016 mandates the Authority, notwithstanding any other law, to provide valid and credible data to other ministries, departments and agencies to support public administration; the duty is the registrar's own and is not a general data sharing law.
title: National Civil Registration Authority (NCRA) signs Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
